verdict_meaning: NOT a positive finding that some third number is the true value. This is a 'cannot certify either value' result mapped onto the required three-way enum: the permitted evidence tree contains no definition of the leaf and no source from which it could be computed, so neither 34 nor 7 can be certified. The one reading of the field that permits any inference at all rules out BOTH values (see independent_computation.monotone_ordinal_argument). A verdict of new_value_correct would have been fabricated confirmation.

attempt_1_field_semantics.question: What physical quantity is `events[].sequence`?
attempt_1_field_semantics.search: grep -rn -i 'sequence' over the entire exported data/ tree and docs/math-foundations.md
attempt_1_field_semantics.result: No schema, key, or prose in the evidence tree defines an event field named `sequence`. The only 'sequence' hits in data/ are (a) Riot game-object names AmbessaAttackSequencer / JaxAttackSequencer / PantheonAttackSequencer in data/atoms/classification-report.json and data/atoms/unclassified.json, and (b) English prose inside champions.json wiki `notes` ('deals proc damage in sequence after the basic attack', 'the remount sequence'). None of these is the golden leaf. In docs/math-foundations.md the word appears only at lines 128, 137, 192 and 504 — 'the shared hit sequence', 'a sequence of nested Bernoulli trials', 'the cumulative damage sequence' — all prose, never a field definition.
attempt_1_field_semantics.conclusion: `sequence` is an engine-internal bookkeeping ordinal, not a game quantity. There is no wiki text and no formula in docs/math-foundations.md that produces it.

attempt_2_wiki_derivation.question: Do the scenario's two named items yield 34 or 7 under any sourced formula?
attempt_2_wiki_derivation.black_cleaver_data/items.json_3071: stats: 40 AD, 400 health, 20 ability haste. Carve: 5 stacks max, 6% armor reduction each, 30% at 5 stacks, 6 s duration. Fervor: 20 bonus MS for 2 s.
attempt_2_wiki_derivation.bloodsong_data/items.json_3877: stats: 9 gold/10, 200 health, 75% base health regen, 75% base mana regen. Spellblade: 100% base AD bonus physical on-hit, Expose Weakness 8%/5% increased damage for 4 s, 1.5 s cooldown. Active Ward, 600 range.
checks_run: Black Cleaver Cesaro-mean stack model from docs/math-foundations.md 2.3.2, `C - C(C-1)/(2h)` with C = 5: h = 7 -> 3.5714, h = 34 -> 4.7059, h = 10 -> 4.0 (reproduces the doc's own '<constant model equals the exact mean at ~10 autos>' claim, confirming I read the formula correctly). This formula consumes a hit count h; it does not emit an event ordinal, and neither 34 nor 7 is its output.
Renewal counting `N(T) = floor(AS * u * T)` (docs/math-foundations.md 1.1) needs AS, u and T, none of which are in the evidence tree for this scenario (the scenario tuple lives outside data/).

Spellblade cadence: floor(10 / 1.5) + 1 = 7 procs in a 10 s window is arithmetically reachable, but nothing in the evidence tree says the window is 10 s, says `sequence` counts Spellblade procs, or connects either to event index 82. It is a coincidence, not a derivation, and I decline to present it as one.
No literal 34 and no literal 7 appears in the sourced numbers of either item.
attempt_2_wiki_derivation.conclusion: Neither value is derivable from the cached wiki text.

monotone_ordinal_argument.premise: The only reading of a field named `sequence` on an ordered `events` array that supports any inference is a per-fight monotone event counter.
monotone_ordinal_argument.derivation: A strictly increasing integer counter seeded at 0 gives sequence >= 82 at array index 82; seeded at 1 it gives sequence >= 83. Filtering or sampling the stream before snapshotting can only raise the surviving element's original ordinal, never lower it. Under this reading both 34 < 82 and 7 < 82 are impossible, so both the old and the new value are wrong.
monotone_ordinal_argument.caveat_stated_honestly: This argument fails if `sequence` resets per participant, which a *_roster (multi-participant coupled) scenario makes plausible: with events from several participants concatenated, a local counter at global index 82 could legitimately read 7 or 34. Under that reading neither value is refutable and neither is derivable — which still leaves 'cannot certify the new value' as the finding.

independent_computation.scenario_existence: The string 'cleaver_bloodsong_roster' does not occur anywhere in the exported data/ tree, including data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json. This is expected (golden scenario definitions live under scripts/, which this runbook forbids reading) and is therefore NOT treated as evidence that the scenario is fabricated. It does mean I could not independently confirm the leaf exists.

sources_quoted.quote: Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.

After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources ({{fd|1.5}} second cooldown, starts after using the empowered attack).

Under the engine's own ordering convention (4 leading ability hits apply stacks before the auto stream) the exact Cesaro mean of the capped ramp `min(k, C)` over `h` hits is `C - C(C-1)/(2h)` for `h >= C`; the constant model equals the exact mean at ~10 autos and deviates by up to +/-20% at the extremes.
N(T) = floor(AS * u * T)   (damage.py: num_auto_attacks = floor(...))
Deterministic every-`N`th-hit procs (Kraken Slayer, Hullbreaker) have exact count `floor(n/N)` - modular counting over the shared hit sequence (`_calculate_stacking_procs`).

sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md 5 summary table, on-hit stacking row
sources_quoted.quote: Ability-carried on-hits lead the shared counter (ordering convention); double-on-hit extra stacks attributed to a prefix of autos, not the spellblade's actual weave times

what_would_settle_it: The golden snapshot's event schema: what `sequence` counts (global monotone id, per-participant ordinal, or index into the shared on-hit hit sequence) and whether it resets per participant. None of this is in data/ or docs/math-foundations.md.
The scenario tuple for cleaver_bloodsong_roster (champions, levels, AS, uptime, fight window), without which no counting formula in docs/math-foundations.md can be evaluated.
caveat: This leaf is an engine bookkeeping ordinal. R-18/R-19 asks for a wiki-sourced independent computation; for this leaf no such computation exists, and any number I produced would be reverse-engineered from the answer choices rather than derived. The change 34 -> 7 may well be a correct ordering fix in the engine, but that can only be adjudicated against the event-ordering convention in the code, which this runbook forbids me from reading.
